== History ==

''Empire of Azeroth'' was the first ever founded clan in Europe. They were also the hosts of Germany's notorious 'Splatterfest' servers. 

== Information ==

* Founded: 1996-02-27
* Nationality: [[Image:flag_de.gif]] German 
* Clan prefix: EA
* IRC channel: #azeroth.qw and #azeroth on quakenet
* Website: http://www.azeroth.org/
